 Summary Statement
 Obligation to provide a confidential report has been met and all initial reporting and compliance measures have been taken to comply with the Conflict of Interest Act .
 Recusal
 On February 16, 2024, in the exercise of my official duties as Deputy Director of Communications in the Office of the Prime Minister, I recused myself from participating in discussions and communications on a matter relating to a client of Hill & Knowlton Strategies in order to avoid any conflict of interest between my official functions and the private interests of my partner, Eric Dillane, Account Director at Hill and Knowlton Strategies.
 On November 20, 2023, in the exercise of my official duties as Strategic Communications Advisor in the Office of the Prime Minister, I recused myself from participating in discussions, meetings and communications on a matter relating to a client of Hill & Knowlton Strategies in order to avoid any conflict of interest between my official functions and the private interests of my partner, Eric Dillane, Account Director at Hill and Knowlton Strategies.
